name: OptionResolver
usage_hint: Invisible resolver that listens for option:changed events and emits variant:changed with matched variant data (price, image, availability).
when_to_use: On product pages with multiple options (size, color, etc.). Place alongside VariantSelector islands. This island has no UI — it's pure logic that coordinates option selections into a resolved variant.
when_not_to_use: For single-variant products (no options). When BuyBox already handles variant resolution internally. Don't use multiple OptionResolvers on one page.
combine_with: ProductGallery or a native product image
anti_patterns: Providing incomplete variant data (missing selectedOptions) — resolver can't match
Using without VariantSelector islands to emit option:changed (nothing will trigger it)
Expecting OptionResolver to validate inventory — it only matches, use InventoryIndicator for stock checks
